                # builtin "bind".

        sys.exit(0)
    else:

        sys.exit(0)

        sys.stdout.write(REMOVE_HELP); sys.exit(0)
    if subargs[0] in ('-V','--version') and len(subargs)==1:
        print_version(); sys.exit(0)
    # simulate removal
    for p in subargs:
        print(p)
    sys.exit(0)
else:
    # Unknown command: print main help
    print_main_help(); sys.exit(1)

executable

git commit -m "Implement zoxide-like CLI stub" || true

echo "Compiled ./executable"
EOF

./compile.sh

# Quick verification
./executable --help | sed -n '1,120p'
./executable --version
./executable add
./executable init bash | sed -n '1,40p'
